message.content: Now let me look at the build script and the fuzzer harness to understand how to build and test:

content:
Here's the result of running `cat -n` on /workspace/repo-vul/src-vul/build.sh:
     1	./autogen.sh
     2	./configure
     3	make clean
     4	make -j$(nproc)
     5	FUZZ_SRCDIR=harnesses
     6	FUZZ_TARGET=fuzzer
     7	$CC $CFLAGS -o $FUZZ_SRCDIR/fuzzer_syntax.o -I src -c -DSYNTAX_TEST $FUZZ_SRCDIR/base.c
     8	$CXX $CXXFLAGS -o $OUT/$FUZZ_TARGET $FUZZ_SRCDIR/fuzzer_syntax.o $LIB_FUZZING_ENGINE src/.libs/libonig.a
     9	cp $FUZZ_SRCDIR/$FUZZ_TARGET.options $OUT/
    10	cp $FUZZ_SRCDIR/ascii_compatible.dict $OUT/$FUZZ_TARGET.dict
    11
